domain.quantityConstructors: All primitive string/number/bigint inputs described by UnitCode, QuantityInput, ratio, decimal parsing, scaling, and safe-number signatures, including every invalid-input rejection branch.
domain.quantityAlgebra: All values returned by the certified quantity constructors and all QuantityRatio values returned by quantityRatio; exact operations include negative/zero/positive values wherever their declarations allow them.
domain.measurementConstructors: All primitive axis strings, certified Quantity values, finite plain readonly arrays, and InventoryIndependentMeasurementInput records described by the declarations, including every duplicate/axis/unit/sign rejection branch.
domain.measurementAlgebra: All normalized InventoryMeasurementVector values returned by inventoryMeasurementVector/scalarInventoryMeasurements and finite schemas described by their declarations.
domain.builtIns: Unmodified ECMAScript String, RegExp, Array, Map, Object-free record construction, JSON, Math, Number, BigInt, and Error behavior at the exact compiler-resolved TypeScript library declarations recorded by the certificate.
domain.immutability: Inputs are finite acyclic plain immutable records/arrays containing primitive fields and certified quantity/vector values; fresh local arrays/maps may be mutated only while constructing results.
domain.excluded: Proxies, accessors, subclass instances, cyclic arrays, monkey-patched built-ins, coercive custom objects, ambient replacements, and externally mutable inputs are not admitted. Storage, clocks, I/O, randomness, and application callbacks are absent from this family.

memberEquations.name: addInventoryMeasurements
memberEquations.law: Require equal primary axis/unit, add primary exactly, merge independent axes by identity with exact same-unit addition, then validate and sort the resulting vector.

memberEquations.name: assertInventoryMeasurementsFollowPrimarySign
memberEquations.law: Compare primary and each independent axis to exact same-scale zero; reject nonzero axes at zero primary and signs opposed to primary.

body: ' cannot be negative while primary is positive.

memberEquations.name: assertWholeMeasurementMultiple
memberEquations.law: Require equal primary schema and a whole positive primary multiple; every axis declared by oneWhole must equal that same exact package-count multiple, with absent value axes read as zero.

memberEquations.name: inventoryMeasurement
memberEquations.law: Reject an axis whose primitive text trims empty and otherwise retain the exact axis text and quantity in a fresh pair.

body: Measurement axisId must not be empty.
Measurement axisId must not contain surrounding whitespace.

memberEquations.name: inventoryMeasurementAt
memberEquations.law: Return a matching primary/independent quantity only in the requested unit, throw on unit mismatch, and return exact zero when an independent axis is absent.

memberEquations.name: inventoryMeasurementVector
memberEquations.law: Revalidate the primary and every independent pair, reject reuse of the primary axis, sort by UTF-16 identity order, reject duplicates, and return a fresh normalized vector.

body: Independent measurement cannot reuse the primary axisId.

memberEquations.name: inventoryMeasurementsAreZero
memberEquations.law: Return true exactly when primary and every independent quantity equal exact same-unit/same-scale zero.

memberEquations.name: inventoryMeasurementsEqual
memberEquations.law: Require identical primary axis/value, equal ordered independent lengths, and identical axis/value at every normalized index.

memberEquations.name: inventoryMeasurementsFingerprint
memberEquations.law: Encode primary and ordered independent axis fingerprints as one finite collision-free JSON array after recursively rejecting undefined/non-finite numbers.

memberEquations.name: multiplyInventoryMeasurementsByWholeNumber
memberEquations.law: Require a strictly positive safe integer multiplier, multiply every exact axis, and normalize the returned vector.

body: Inventory measurement multiplier must be a positive safe integer.

memberEquations.name: negateInventoryMeasurements
memberEquations.law: Negate every exact axis and normalize the returned vector without changing axis/unit/scale identities.

memberEquations.name: nonNegativeInventoryMeasurements
memberEquations.law: Reject any negative axis and reject retained independent quantity when primary is zero; otherwise return the same vector identity.

body: primary quantity must not be negative.
cannot keep independent measurements after primary stock reaches zero.

memberEquations.name: positiveInventoryMeasurements
memberEquations.law: Require strictly positive primary and every independent axis non-negative; otherwise throw the axis-specific error and return the same vector on success.

memberEquations.name: scalarInventoryMeasurements
memberEquations.law: Build one validated primary measurement and normalize it with no independent axes.

memberEquations.name: subtractInventoryMeasurements
memberEquations.law: Negate the right vector and add through the complete same-schema vector equation.

memberEquations.name: zeroInventoryMeasurements
memberEquations.law: Construct exact zero for every axis using each input axis unit and decimal scale, then normalize the returned vector.

memberEquations.name: addQuantity
memberEquations.law: Require equal units, align to the larger decimal scale, add exact bigint digits, require a safe stored integer, and return that scale/unit.

memberEquations.name: assertSameUnit
memberEquations.law: Return normally exactly when the two unit codes are identical; otherwise throw the fixed unit-mismatch error.

memberEquations.name: compareQuantity
memberEquations.law: Require equal units, align both exact integers to max scale, then return -1, 0, or 1 by mathematical ordering.

memberEquations.name: convertQuantityByReferenceExact
memberEquations.law: Require the input/source unit match and both references positive; evaluate value * targetReference / sourceReference as a reduced finite decimal in the target unit.

memberEquations.name: convertQuantityExact
memberEquations.law: Revalidate and reduce the positive ratio, then evaluate amount * numerator / denominator as a reduced finite decimal in the explicit target unit.

memberEquations.name: integerAtDecimals
memberEquations.law: Validate the target scale, reject digit-removing scales, and multiply exact stored digits by ten to the scale difference.

body: Target decimals cannot remove exact quantity digits.

memberEquations.name: leastCommonQuantityMultiple
memberEquations.law: Require same-unit positive operands, align scale, and return (left / gcd(left,right)) * right with safe exact storage.

memberEquations.name: multiplyQuantityByFactor
memberEquations.law: Require a positive factor, add operand scales within the allowed bound, multiply exact bigint digits, and use the factor unit.

memberEquations.name: multiplyQuantityByWholeNumber
memberEquations.law: Require a safe integer multiplier and multiply exact digits through bigint without changing unit or scale.

memberEquations.name: negateQuantity
memberEquations.law: Return the validated exact additive inverse with unchanged scale and unit.

memberEquations.name: parseQuantity
memberEquations.law: Trim primitive text, accept only signed plain decimal notation, enforce at most 18 fractional digits, convert concatenated digits exactly, and validate unit/storage.

body: Quantity text must be a plain decimal number.
Quantity text has too many decimal places.

memberEquations.name: positiveQuantity
memberEquations.law: Return the same validated quantity identity only when stored digits are strictly positive; otherwise throw the label-specific error.

memberEquations.name: quantity
memberEquations.law: Require safe integer digits, an integer decimal scale from 0 through 18, and a trimmed non-empty unit; return a fresh exact record.

memberEquations.name: quantityEq
memberEquations.law: Return false for unequal units; otherwise compare exact aligned numeric values for equality.

memberEquations.name: quantityIsWholeMultipleOf
memberEquations.law: Require same unit and positive divisor, align scale, and test exact bigint remainder for zero.

memberEquations.name: quantityRatio
memberEquations.law: Require positive safe integer numerator/denominator, divide both by their bigint gcd, and return safe reduced integers.

body: Quantity conversion ratio must be positive.

memberEquations.name: quantityToDecimalString
memberEquations.law: Render sign and absolute safe digits in plain decimal notation, left-padding fractional zeroes and never using exponent notation.

memberEquations.name: quantityWholeMultipleCount
memberEquations.law: Require same unit, positive divisor, non-negative value, and zero exact remainder; return the safe integer quotient.

body: Whole-unit quantity value must not be negative.
Quantity is not a whole-number multiple of the requested unit.

memberEquations.name: safeNumber

memberEquations.name: subtractQuantity

memberEquations.name: unitCode

body: Quantity unit must not be empty.

memberEquations.name: zeroQuantity
